sources.title: Article 4 direction dataset
sources.facts: 3,167 directions; 101 providers; small-group/specification-development dataset; collector 2026-07-28; new data 2026-07-21.
sources.guard: Dataset coverage is partial and does not prove a direction applies to a specific parcel.

sources.title: Article 4 direction area dataset
sources.facts: 7,152 areas; 111 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-27.
sources.guard: Area geometry still requires exact legal instrument and current-status verification.

sources.title: Permitted development right dataset
sources.facts: 240 rights; 1 provider; experimental; collector 2026-07-29; new data 2026-07-25.
sources.guard: A category vocabulary is not confirmation that a right is available or withdrawn at a site.

sources.title: Permitted development right part dataset
sources.facts: 21 parts; 1 provider; experimental; collector 2026-07-26; new data 2024-02-21.
sources.guard: Part grouping is taxonomy, not legal applicability.

sources.title: Article 4 direction specification
sources.facts: Specification requires at least one row per direction and rights from the PDR dataset.
sources.guard: A conformant schema does not validate an instrument's legal currency.

sources.title: Article 4 planning consideration
sources.facts: Design stage shown as on-platform with constraint/PDR tags.
sources.guard: Design-stage metadata is not a site decision.

sources.title: Article 4 screening record
sources.facts: Screen references GPDO 2015 Article 4 and consultation workflow.
sources.guard: Screening content is workflow research, not authoritative parcel determination.

sources.title: Article 4 South entity
sources.facts: Entity links to Bristol documentation for a named Article 4 direction.
sources.guard: Entity/documentation presence does not prove current scope without instrument readback.
